title: Coordenador(a) de Orientação de Alunos - Escola Técnica Roberto Rocca
description:
Coordenador(a) de Orientação de Alunos - Escola Técnica Roberto Rocca

Join to apply for the Coordenador(a) de Orientação de Alunos - Escola Técnica Roberto Rocca role at Ternium

Finalidade da Posição

  • Seu principal objetivo é acompanhar e potencializar o desenvolvimento integral de cada estudante. Para isso, deve estabelecer um plano de trabalho com ações individuais e em grupo.
  • Deve contar com estratégias de diagnóstico de necessidades, assessorias personalizadas (coaching humano e acadêmico), workshops, qualificação docente e estratégias de cultura escolar.
  • A função é composta por uma equipe multidisciplinar de: psicólogos, psicopedagogos, assistentes sociais e docentes da mesma Escola.
  • Deve trabalhar em coordenação com a área de Pedagogia (desenvolvimento de carreira), para gerar um plano de vida e carreira de acordo com as pretensões e talentos de cada estudante, mantendo estreita coordenação com o mentor responsável pela turma.
  • Implementar os programas de atendimento psicopedagógico para os Alunos da Escola Técnica Roberto Rocca.
  • Estabelecer o programa de apoio e orientação escolar dos Alunos no contexto escolar e de desenvolvimento pessoal.
  • Conhecer os alunos e suas famílias como parte do processo de Admissão dos Alunos, por meio de entrevistas e implementação de instrumentos que determinem a possibilidade de admissão à Escola Técnica Roberto Rocca a partir do ponto de vista psicopedagógico.
  • Estabelecer os programas de interação com os pais dos alunos bem como implementar o Curso de Certificação Escolar para Pais.
  • Estabelecer o programa permanente de Mentorias acadêmicas para os Alunos.
  • Encaminhar à instância correspondente os casos de Alunos com problemas maiores detectados direta ou indiretamente pela área de Orientação Escolar.
  • Manter o abandono escolar no mínimo possível.
  • Coordenar os líderes de grupo a fim de instaurar uma cultura de disciplina positiva na Escola Técnica Roberto Rocca.

Funções Funcionais do cargo

  • Coordenar os mentores (docentes da Escola Técnica Roberto Rocca que trabalham como mentores acadêmicos), orientadores e líderes de grupo (agora haverá monitores que precisarão ampliar o perfil na Escola Rocca) para um acompanhamento dos planos de vida e carreira dos alunos, bem como a implementação do Curso de Certificação Escolar para Pais.
  • Junto à Diretoria, determinar os critérios e as ferramentas a serem utilizadas para fins de aceitação da entrada de alunos a partir da perspectiva psicopedagógica.
  • Dar apoio por meio de programas de atendimento psicopedagógico no processo de formação dos Alunos, tanto no contexto curricular quanto extracurricular, incluindo o processo de Admissão e suas diversas etapas, até a conclusão dos estudos dos Alunos.
  • Em coordenação com as áreas acadêmicas, estabelecer um Programa integral de Orientação escolar e de Mentorias acadêmicas e de Desenvolvimento pessoal para os Alunos da Escola Rocca.
  • Elaborar os procedimentos aplicáveis à sua função, bem como o Regulamento interno da Escola para sua aprovação e implementação.
  • Definir os Programas de interação entre a Escola Rocca e os pais ou mentores dos alunos.

Características do perfil

  • Contar com experiência na aplicação de testes psicométricos e na implementação de estratégias que ajudem a corrigir situações encontradas neles.
  • Contar com competências de informática para o manuseio de dados, informações e relatórios.
  • Ser proativo e responder a desafios e metas altas, demonstrando velocidade, mobilidade e flexibilidade em suas abordagens, sendo um iniciador versátil que procura e corrige, quando necessário e de forma rápida, a fim de se aproximar das metas definidas.
  • Atualizar-se constantemente nas mudanças curriculares da escola, da organização docente e de políticas educacionais.
  • Possuir habilidades de comunicação eficiente com as diversas áreas da instituição, com estudantes e pais, controlando suas reações e temperamento mediante situações de conflito para manter uma negociação inteligente.
  • Conhecer as relações entre o contexto e os fatores culturais que envolvem a instituição.
  • Conhecer o projeto da escola e se identificar com o histórico e ideias fundamentais da instituição.
  • Conhecer e ter a capacidade de expressar suas próprias necessidades com estabilidade emocional e autoconfiança, refletindo um estado emocional adequado para cada circunstância.
  • Mostrar respeito com os outros, respeitando a individualidade das pessoas e valorizando sua dignidade.
  • Mostrar valor com relação à solidariedade, por sua liderança positiva e o exercício de suas competências sociais, incluindo a tendência a interagir, respeitar e fomentar as práticas, normas e os bons costumes estabelecidos em seu entorno social.
  • Coordenar equipes de trabalho de forma eficiente.

Responsabilidades

  • Conhecer os estudantes e suas famílias considerando as características socioeconômicas, culturais e os antecedentes educacionais de cada estudante.
  • Focar na retenção de estudantes, acompanhando-os junto com suas famílias para que possam perceber os benefícios de concluir o bacharelado técnico em termos pessoais e econômicos.
  • Implementar estratégias com sua equipe de trabalho e docentes para realizar a ação de mentoria: observação, entrevista, dinâmicas de grupo, etc., considerando a influência do desenvolvimento humano.
  • Por meio de um trabalho multidisciplinar, articular estratégias de acompanhamento com as atividades acadêmicas dos estudantes.
  • Fazer o encaminhamento de estudantes que demandam atendimento profissional.
  • Mapear e estabelecer relações de apoio com instituições adequadas para o encaminhamento de casos específicos (alcoolismo, vício em drogas, gravidez, síndrome de Asperger, violência, abuso, etc.).
  • Implementar uma estratégia eficiente de acompanhamento, demonstrando empatia com os estudantes por meio de condutas de calma e valor mediante circunstâncias difíceis.
  • Melhorar o programa de escola para pais de acordo com as necessidades da população estudantil.
  • Coordenar e implementar a documentação do plano de vida e carreira dos estudantes, considerando o desenvolvimento acadêmico (orientação acadêmica-pedagógica-docente) e pessoal (mentoria).
  • Criar um clima escolar positivo permeado por práticas e políticas alinhadas com a disciplina positiva, por meio de atividades, relações positivas, intervenções e políticas sistêmicas.
  • Desenvolver nos estudantes as habilidades socioemocionais, condutas pró-sociais e o plano de vida e carreira.
  • Facilitar para que os alunos se integrem socialmente e no trabalho com um alto nível social, acadêmico e de trabalho.
  • Facilitar e promover que os alunos sintam gratidão e tenham espírito de serviço.

Formação

  • Graduação em Pedagogia / Psicologia
  • Especialização em Psicopedagogia

Experiência

  • Atuação em escolas, especialmente no Ensino Médio
  • Foco no bem-estar dos alunos, alinhado à parte educacional
  • Gestão e desenvolvimento de projetos educacionais
  • Liderança e trabalho em equipe

Habilidades e Responsabilidades

  • Coordenação e liderança de orientadores educacionais e psicóloga
  • Gestão da equipe de orientação educacional
  • Parceria com a coordenação pedagógica
  • Desenvolvimento e implementação de estratégias para o acompanhamento dos alunos

Local de trabalho

Santa Cruz | Escola Técnica Roberto Rocca

* Lembramos que a Ternium é uma empresa que se preocupa com a inclusão, por isso, todas as nossas vagas também são destinadas à Pessoas com Deficiência e Reabilitados pelo INSS.

title: Power Electronics Developer
description:
Job Purpose

About Us: At TechnipFMC, within the Controls & Automation product line, we are pioneering technology platforms for the electrification of Subsea Control Systems and the advancement of renewable energy sources such as offshore wind, hydrogen, and wave energy.

Our Team: The Electronics R&D team works across a broad spectrum of technologies, including analog electronics, FPGA, SoC, power design, safety design, motor controllers, processor design, and power line modems. These technologies are integral to various control system applications.

Your Role: As part of the Controls & Automation team at TechnipFMC, you will engage in the design, development, qualification, system integration, and production of new products, from commissioning to field operation. Our multidisciplinary development environment includes HW, SW, system, test, mechatronics, and production engineering teams working collaboratively.

We are seeking Senior Power Electronics Developers with expertise in motor control and battery management systems to join our Hardware development team.

Job Description
  • Define hardware requirements in collaboration with system, drive train, and battery management system architects and developers.
  • Design and develop motor drive and battery management circuits, PCBAs, and modules, including component selection, schematic drawing, PCB layout, and prototype building.
  • Conduct functional verification of motor drive and battery management system circuits, PCBAs, sub-assemblies, and electrical actuators.
  • Collaborate with systems architects, mechanical designers, PCB layout, manufacturing, reliability, and SW engineering teams to design and develop power electronics products.
  • Create test procedures and write test reports on functional, environmental, system operation mode, and manufacturing testing of custom power electronic designs.
You are meant for this job if:
  • Analog electronics, including discrete design with Opamps, transistors, inductors, transformers, and capacitors for high voltage designs.
  • Component selection of high voltage power semiconductors (IGBTs, MOSFETs, diodes) for gate drives and analog/digital measurement circuits.
  • Power electronics design across various topologies in the AC or DC domain for motor controllers, battery management circuits, power supplies, and switches.
  • Schematic design and PCB layout using ECAD tools like Altium Designer or equivalent.
  • Knowledge of motor drive and battery control topologies, semiconductor component performance, and loss mechanisms.
  • Experience with lab instruments such as oscilloscopes, network analyzers, signal generators, programmable loads, motor, and battery simulators.
  • Expertise in PCB layout for optimal component placement, reduced stray inductance/capacitance, improved manufacturability, and EMC compliance.
  • Knowledge of control algorithms and embedded programming for circuit design verification.
  • Experience in power electronics design optimized for DFX requirements (manufacturability and testability).
  • Understanding of EMC requirements and CE certification relevant to motor controller design in control system applications.

Qualifications:

  • BSc, MSc, or PhD in electronics, automation, cybernetics, or a related engineering field.
  • 3-5 years of industrial experience in relevant power electronics development and industrialization.
  • Ability to approach complex problems structurally.
  • Open-minded, professional English proficiency, and adaptability to work in a multicultural environment.
  • Continuously raising standards, innovative, and solution oriented.
  • Interest in electronics is an additional advantage.

What We Offer:

  • Exciting global R&D environment.
  • Engaging tasks and work-life balance.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • State-of-the-art development environment.
  • Training and career development opportunities.
  • Comprehensive insurance and pension plans.

title: Coordenador(a) de Projetos - Instalação e Rollout 4G/5G
description:
Coordenador(a) de Projetos - Instalação e Rollout 4G/5G

Gestão do Controle de Implantação (Rollout Control Management): Responsável por coordenar e monitorar todas as etapas do processo de implantação, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos, escopo e qualidade definidos.

Atualização de Metas (Target Update): Realizar revisões periódicas das metas do projeto, ajustando indicadores conforme o progresso e mudanças estratégicas.

Acompanhamento de Status Congelado (Frozen Follow-up): Monitorar e reportar atividades ou entregas que estejam em status de congelamento, identificando causas e propondo soluções para retomada.

Acompanhamento de MOS (MOS Follow-up): Gerenciar o cumprimento dos procedimentos operacionais definidos (Method of Statement ou Management Operating System), assegurando alinhamento entre equipes e conformidade com padrões técnicos.

Acompanhamento de Instalação (Installation Follow-up): Supervisionar o progresso das atividades de instalação, garantindo que sejam realizadas conforme os requisitos técnicos e dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.

Acompanhamento de Aceite (Acceptance Follow-up): Controlar o processo de aceite das entregas do projeto, validando documentação, testes e conformidade técnica junto aos stakeholders.

Gestão de Projetos: Atuar em projetos de média a alta complexidade, exigindo habilidades de planejamento, análise de riscos, comunicação entre áreas e tomada de decisão estratégica.

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia, Administração, Logística, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Certificações em gestão de projetos (desejável): PMP, Scrum, Prince2.
  • Experiência com gestão de projetos técnicos e/ou de implantação (rollout).
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de acompanhamento de projetos (ex: MOS, Agile, PMBOK).
  • Capacidade de realizar follow-up estruturado com múltiplas equipes (instalação, aceite, metas).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de projetos (ex: MS Project, Jira, Trello, SAP).
  • Habilidade para lidar com projetos de média a alta complexidade.
  • Experiência com controle de cronogramas, entregas e documentação técnica.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em modelo presencial em São Paulo (Zona Sul).

Horário de Trabalho e Benefícios

  • Vale Refeição
  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Participação de Lucros

title: Recruitment Manager
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients. Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the role

Darkroom is seeking a dedicated and experienced Recruiting Manager to lead our talent acquisition team and strategy. You will be the crucial link between our senior leadership and the execution of our hiring plan, ensuring we attract and hire top talent efficiently and effectively to support Darkroom’s ambitious growth goals.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Team Leadership & Coordination: Coordinate the daily activities, priorities, and resources of the recruiting team (including Senior Recruiters, Recruiters, and Coordinators) to ensure alignment with company objectives and hiring targets.
  • Strategic Partnership (SPOC): Serve as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for Darkroom's senior leadership, providing regular updates, strategic insights, and recommendations on hiring status, market conditions, and talent pipeline health.
  • Hiring Plan Execution: Own the delivery of the overall hiring plan. Proactively ensure all open positions are filled in the right time, managing requisition load and balancing team efforts across various departments (e.g., Engineering, Product, G&A, Sales).
  • Process Optimization: Continuously evaluate and refine our end-to-end recruitment processes, tools, and systems to maximize efficiency, candidate experience, and hiring quality.
  • Data & Reporting: Develop and present key recruiting metrics, reports, and dashboards to senior leadership, leveraging data to drive decision-making and forecast hiring needs.
  • Vendor Management: Manage relationships with external recruiting agencies, sourcing partners, and vendors as needed.
  • Recruiter Development: Mentor, coach, and develop the recruiting team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, high performance, and deep business acumen.

Standard Requirements

  • Experience: A minimum of 5+ years of progressive experience in Talent Acquisition or Recruiting, with at least 2 years of experience managing, leading, or mentoring a team of recruiters.
  • Leadership: Proven ability to lead and motivate a high-performing recruiting team in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Communication: Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and articulate hiring strategy and data to executive-level stakeholders.
  • Strategic Mindset: Demonstrated experience in translating business objectives into tactical recruiting strategies and operational plans.
  • Process Acumen: Deep understanding of full-cycle recruiting, best practices, and the ability to implement effective sourcing, interviewing, and closing strategies.
  • System Knowledge: Proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) (e.g., Greenhouse, Lever) and experience using data visualization/reporting tools.
  • Compliance: Strong knowledge of employment laws and compliance regulations related to hiring.

Why Darkroom

Darkroom builds the future of how brands grow. As Recruitment Manager, you’ll support that mission — helping shape the company by ensuring we pick the right candidates that make us what we are. You’ll collaborate with world-class operators, creatives, and data minds to build the next generation of marketing excellence.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Work-Life Balance: We recognize that time away from work is essential for growth and well-being. Our generous paid time off policy ensures you have the time you need to maintain a healthy work-life balance and perform at your best.
  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona! For NYC and Lisbon applicants a Hybrid model will be required.
  • Health & Wellness: Company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision benefits with, so you can stay as healthy as can be.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: IT Project Manager (SAP S4 Service)
description:
Project Manager – SAP S4 Service

Introduction

Are you passionate about driving digital transformation in field service operations in a global environment? Do you have excellent technical skills—especially with SAP ECC CS and ideally SAP S/4HANA Service? We are seeking a hands-on Implementation Manager with deep SAP expertise to lead and deliver projects as part of our Global Technical Operations Team. Join us and shape our field service ecosystem, optimizing business processes, and ensuring technical excellence across our organization.

Your Responsibilities

  • Project Leadership: Independently manage and deliver complex implementation projects for our SAP-integrated Field Service Management system—from requirements engineering and solution design to Go-Live.
  • Technical System Configuration & Assessment: Utilize your expertise in SAP ECC CS and S/4HANA Service to evaluate available configuration options, enhancement frameworks (e.g., ABAP, User Exits, BADIs, RICEFW), and integration touchpoints with external Field Service Management platforms. Collaborate with IT and development teams to translate functional needs into robust technical system configurations, while adhering to established system capabilities and governance frameworks ensuring optimal alignment with business requirements and technical standards.
  • Interface & Integration Management: Analyze, design, and optimize interfaces between SAP modules (ECC CS, SD, S/4HANA Service) and third-party applications, ensuring robust system communication and data flows (IDOCs).
  • Process Optimization: Analyze and document business processes and technical workflows, focusing on automation, data quality, and system efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Management: Collaborate closely with both business and IT stakeholders, translating business requirements into technical solutions and acting as a technical consultant and change manager.
  • Data Quality & Business Intelligence: Develop, maintain, and optimize reporting solutions and analytics, ensuring high data consistency and reliability.
  • Training & Support: Deliver technical trainings, create documentation, and provide expert support to users and project teams.
  • Lifecycle Management: Support application lifecycle including 2nd level support.

Your Profile

  • 4-6 years of hands‑on experience with SAP ECC CS module and ideally SAP S/4HANA Service, including Customizing, technical configuration, and enhancement technologies (e.g., ABAP, BADIs, User Exits).
  • Deep understanding of SAP integration concepts (IDoc, RFC, Web Services, APIs) and experience in connecting SAP with external systems.
  • Proven track record in technical project management especially in IT/business process implementation projects.
  • Strong experience in interface design, data modelling, and system troubleshooting.
  • High attention to detail and passion for data quality.

Additional Skills

  • Hands‑on mentality, high IT affinity and willingness to learn about new IT systems, especially in the field of cloud and mobile applications.
  • Assertive and confident in technical discussions and decision‑making.
  • Team player with excellent collaboration and communication skills.
  • Willingness to travel internationally, as required.
  • Knowledge in SQL, SAP Field Service Management and Jira considered as a plus.
  • Fluent in English (Spanish is a plus).

Education

  • University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Informatics, or a related discipline; or equivalent professional experience.

Our Offer

There is a lot for you to discover at Fresenius Medical Care, because we have a lot to offer. No matter in which field you are an expert and how much experience you bring with you - for your professional future with meaning:

  • The opportunity to shape the future of healthcare innovation at a global market leader.
  • A highly collaborative, mission‑driven, and innovative culture.
  • Global exposure, challenging assignments, and high visibility.
  • A platform to make a tangible impact in advancing health, sustainability, and innovation.

At Fresenius Medical Care , we are the global leader in kidney care, committed to improving the lives of patients with chronic kidney disease. Our mission is to deliver high‑quality, innovative products, services, and care across the entire healthcare journey. Guided by our vision —“ Creating a future worth living . For patients. Worldwide. Every day.”—we work with purpose and compassion, supported by a global team of over 125,000 employees.

Within our Care Enablement segment, we develop and provide life‑sustaining medical products, digital health solutions, and therapies that empower clinical teams and improve patient outcomes. Our FME Reignite strategy drives transformation through innovation, efficiency, and sustainable growth.

Our values guide how we work:

  • We Care for our patients, each other, and our communities
  • We Connect across teams and borders to deliver excellence together
  • We Commit to doing things the right way— growing with purpose and leading kidney care with integrity and innovation

In an era where great employees can deliver 10‑times the leverage of the merely good, we back those who play to win. Fortune favors the bold. Join us.

  • AI‑Native at every level – From the CEO to day‑one hires, everyone builds and ships with generative AI. If you're not wielding AI, you're not done.
  • Entrepreneurial velocity – Move at founder speed, prototype in hours, and measure in real user outcomes. Slow teams die.

At MSS, we’re more than a marine solutions provider—we’re a team that cares about doing things right. Based in Rio de Janeiro, you’ll join a close-knit HR & Crewing team that thrives on collaboration and respect. We offer:

  • A flexible, energised work environment where ideas are valued.
  • A culture that celebrates diversity and teamwork—“we” comes before “I”.
  • The opportunity to shape the future of our operations and support the growth of new seafarers through our Cadet Programme.

This role is a unique blend of operational excellence and human connection. As a company, we are owned by A.P. Moller Holding, operating independently with the trust and empowerment to do what is right for us, while proudly bearing the Maersk name and values.

What you’ll do

Your mission is simple yet powerful: attract and engage the best maritime talent while ensuring our offshore colleagues feel valued and supported .

You’ll lead initiatives that go beyond filling positions—creating meaningful connections and building trust with candidates and stakeholders. From crafting employer branding to managing end-to-end recruitment, you’ll ensure every interaction reflects our values.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Drive talent attraction strategies aligned with business goals.
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of skilled professionals for offshore roles.
  • Lead the Cadet Programme, supporting the next generation of seafarers.
  • Act as a trusted partner to hiring managers, providing insights and guidance.
  • Champion diversity and inclusion in all recruitment activities and find the candidate with the cultural fit to the company.
  • Continuously improve processes to enhance candidate experience and efficiency.
  • Coordinate offshore recruitment, ensuring compliance with maritime regulations (MLC, STCW, NR-30, Petrobras).
  • Plan and conduct recruitment for key maritime positions: Captain, Chief Officer, Deck Officer, Chief Engineer, 2nd Engineer Officer, Electrician/ETO, Able Seafarers and Motormen, Cooks and Stewards, etc.
  • Monitor KPIs, report results, and propose improvements.
  • Ensure that candidate records, certifications, and technical documentation are updated and accurate.
  • Support audits and collaborate with Payroll, Training & Compliance, and Vessel Operations.
  • Manage onboarding/offboarding and participate in the Crewing Duty Phone rotation.

Operational excellence will underpin your work—maintaining accurate candidate data, ensuring compliance with maritime regulations, and collaborating across HR, Payroll, Training, and Vessel Operations teams. You’ll also contribute to shaping the future of our talent strategy through innovative ideas and quality-driven initiatives.

Who you are

First and foremost, you are passionate about the maritime industry and enjoy building trusted relationships, and you recognize the game‑changing potential by working in crewing and the positive effect that you can bring to people’s life. In addition, we hope you can say yes to the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, HR, or related field.
  • 5+ years’ experience in offshore recruitment.
  • Proficiency in verbal and written English and Portuguese.
  • Knowledge of maritime regulations (MLC, STCW, NR-30, NORMAM).
  • Proven previous experience conducting recruitment processes for maritime positions.
  • Skilled in recruitment platforms and advanced Excel.
  • Strategic mindset, strong networking skills, and ability to work independently.
  • Passion for the maritime industry and commitment to diversity and inclusion.
  • Strong decision‑making, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Experience in lean organisations and proactive process improvement.
  • Makes quality decisions quickly and confidently, even in fast‑paced environments.

How to Apply

If you can imagine yourself in this role, we look forward to hearing from you. Please apply through our website no later than 30 November 2025. We will review and interview on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

About the job

Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) powers the white‑label travel platforms for some of the world’s largest financial institutions and airlines. As our strategic partner portfolio expands, so too does the need for sophisticated technical expertise and dedicated relationship management.

We are seeking a high‑impact Technical Account Manager (TAM) to be a technical liaison for multiple strategic partners. This critical role acts as the connective architect, seamlessly integrating Product, Engineering, Supply, and Customer Experience teams to ensure every partner receives clear, consistent, and exceptionally reliable support for technical inquiries and strategic growth initiatives.

This is a hands‑on, results‑oriented position. You will use your diagnostic skills and analytical abilities to validate incoming issues, structure comprehensive problem reports, and coordinate effectively with engineering. Your main goal is to ensure that all technical escalations are complete, actionable, and correctly prioritized. You will also play a key part in defining and optimizing our global intake, triage, communication, and escalation frameworks, helping partners get timely resolutions while keeping internal teams focused and efficient.

In short, this role requires a blend of investigative curiosity, clear communication, strong organizational skills, and a process‑improvement mindset, applied across a dynamic portfolio of partners and parallel technical workstreams.

What would your day‑to‑day look like

Partner Engagement & Communication

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for multiple B2B partners, each with unique needs, priorities, and communication channels.
  • Translate partner inquiries into structured, actionable requests with complete context.
  • Provide clear updates, timelines, and expectations, ensuring partners feel supported and aligned.

Technical Triage & Analysis

  • Assess and validate reported issues before escalating to engineering, including reproduction steps, logs, context, severity assessment, and relevant data insights.
  • Investigate technical or data‑centric questions using internal tools, dashboards, and SQL; identify whether issues stem from configuration, supply content, product behavior, data quality, or true system defects.
  • Manage and prioritize requests across multiple partners simultaneously, balancing urgency, impact, and engineering bandwidth.

Process & Program Development

  • Improve intake workflows, templates, and triage mechanisms to create consistency across partners.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, supply, and Customer Experience teams to refine escalation paths, service expectations, and communication standards.
  • Contribute to playbooks, documentation, and partner‑facing resources to strengthen transparency and scale operational excellence.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate with a wide and diverse set of stakeholders, including product managers, engineers, supply specialists, Customer Experience teams, and external partner teams.
  • Maintain clear follow‑through, alignment, and ownership across parallel workstreams.
  • Advocate for partner needs while helping internal teams maintain focus and momentum.

An ideal candidate has

  • An excellent communicator who can build trust with partners and internal teams through clarity, consistency, and professionalism.
  • Comfortable operating across several partners at once, with strong prioritization, context‑switching, and organizational skills.
  • Adept at turning ambiguity into clarity and designing repeatable processes that scale.
  • Technically fluent, with experience interpreting logs, analyzing data, exploring APIs, and using monitoring tools to support issue investigation and triage.
  • Experienced in roles such as Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer, Technical Support Engineer, Product Specialist, or a similar hybrid technical‑customer role.
  • Strong judgment in evaluating issue severity, partner impact, and operational urgency.

Nice to Haves

  • Intermediate or advanced SQL skills; experience working with data analysis, BI tools, or large datasets (BigQuery experience is a plus).
  • Familiarity with API debugging, distributed systems, or SaaS platform operations.
  • Experience implementing or optimizing ticketing and triage systems (Zendesk, Jira Service Desk, Salesforce, etc.).
  • Background improving cross‑functional workflows or partner‑facing operations at scale.

Perks and benefits of working with us

The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the Installation Analysis discipline within McDermott. The role solves complex problems, utilizes discipline-specific knowledge, and impacts customer, operational, project, or service activities across the installation team and related groups.

  • Perform conceptual, FEED, and detailed design as per design basis, project specifications, codes, and standards.
  • Lead the Engineering team when acting as a Project Coordinator.
  • Apply knowledge and skills to a wide range of standard and non‑standard situations.
  • Prepare clear and accurate detailed design calculations and reports.
  • Manage time to meet deadlines and budgets, developing short‑term work plans.
  • Communicate and explain complex issues establishing understanding.
  • Provide engineering support onboard installation vessels offshore.
  • Be fully familiar with the project scope, specifications, schedule, and inter‑discipline requirements, raising concerns early and taking appropriate actions.
  • Identify scope changes and promptly raise change notifications and provide supporting documentation and estimates.
  • Interface with all disciplines to develop clash‑free designs.
  • Maintain cooperation with other engineering disciplines, planning, fabrication, marine, and project management teams.
  • Document substantive communications and forward copies to the Discipline Lead Engineer.
  • Assist in preparing bid proposal estimates, including technical query reviews and work‑hour estimates.
  • Raise technical queries to obtain missing information and maintain preferred McDermott procedures.
  • Prepare discipline engineering design basis, philosophies, and technical specifications.
  • Participate in finalizing deliverable lists, ensuring compliance with specifications and functional integrity.
  • Attend project review meetings, vendor meetings, engineering meetings, and offshore site surveys as required.
  • Provide technical direction and review of designers producing Construction/Installation Support Engineering products.
  • Assist procurement personnel in producing discipline equipment, materials, and services.
  • Assist in updating weight reports based on vendor information.
  • Check engineering performed by others within the discipline.
  • Perform design verification through single‑discipline and inter‑discipline checks (IDC).
  • Provide technical support to fabricating queries, including defect/rectification requirements.
  • Keep the lead engineer apprised of all activities and concerns (technical, budgetary, manpower).
  • Assist in providing inputs for planning and forecasting progress reports, including productivity metrics.
  • Participate in internal, customer, and third‑party technical audits of engineering deliverables.
  • Assist lead engineer with responses to customers and agencies on reviews and approvals.
  • Capture lessons learned and enter them into the MDR Lessons Learned system.
  • Act as a resource for less experienced colleagues and guide them on MDR and discipline procedures.
  • Be aware of costs related to own work and the discipline.

Design Environments

  • Pipeline installation discipline: review pipeline installation designs, analyses, and procedures for spools, PLETS and manifolds, and cables.
  • Structural installation discipline: review designs for loadout, transportation, and installation of offshore structures, including barge upgrades/modifications.
  • Naval installation discipline: review naval architecture designs related to all aspects of marine operations covering loadout, transportation, and installation.

Additional Preferred Skills

  • Erection sequences for jackets, topsides, and other structures.
  • Loadout procedures and guidance during operations.
  • Construction lift analyses and procedures (floatover, stacking, roll‑ups).
  • Weighing procedures.
  • Design and detailing of miscellaneous fabrication yard items.
  • Crane arrangements and rigging arrangements.
  • Trailer arrangements/operations, including drawings and procedures.

Essential Qualifications and Education

  • Strong working knowledge of design techniques, analysis methods, and detailed knowledge of relevant standards, codes, and guidelines for onshore and offshore construction.
  • Preferably a Registered Professional Engineer or member of a professional engineering society.

description:
YDUQS, Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

VENHA SER UMA PESSOA ANALISTA DE PERFORMANCE FINANCEIRA DE COBRANÇA SÊNIOR NA YDUQS.

Temos um projeto grandioso e que requer um time com disposição para pensar de forma original, disruptiva, e com objetivo de resolver as grandes questões de hoje na educação: acesso, tecnologia, customização e o sucesso dos nossos alunos.

Somos uma companhia cheia de energia, que já nasceu gigante e com resultados extraordinários. Venha fazer parte desse time!

VENHA TRANSFORMAR VIDAS. INCLUSIVE A SUA.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Orçamento e Forecast: Elaborar, monitorar e revisar o orçamento da área de cobrança, garantindo coerência entre metas financeiras, desempenho histórico e projeções futuras. Realizar análises de variação e construir previsões contínuas de arrecadação, inadimplência e custos operacionais;
  • Responsável pelo acompanhamento e controles das seguintes linhas do resultado financeiro: Multas e juros recebidos e descontos concedidos;
  • Gestão do P&L da Cobrança: Acompanhar e analisar o demonstrativo de resultados (P&L) da operação, assegurando visibilidade e acurácia dos indicadores que impactam o desempenho financeiro. Apoiar o coordenador na leitura e interpretação dos principais drivers de resultado, propondo planos de ação para otimização de margens e rentabilidade;
  • Custo por Real Arrecadado: Calcular e monitorar o custo por real arrecadado, identificando oportunidades de eficiência operacional e de redução de despesas por canal e carteira. Desenvolver análises comparativas entre canais internos, externos e digitais;
  • PDD vs Arrecadação: Realizar análises de sensibilidade entre a Provisão para Devedores Duvidosos (PDD) e a arrecadação, avaliando impacto contábil e orçamentário das estratégias de cobrança. Apoiar a tomada de decisão em políticas de crédito, renegociação e recuperação;
  • Rolagem e LTV: Acompanhar o comportamento de rolagem das carteiras inadimplentes, avaliando a evolução dos saldos ao longo do tempo e o impacto no LTV (Lifetime Value). Desenvolver modelos e relatórios que permitam mensurar o retorno financeiro por cohort e estratégia;
  • Carteira Boletão / DIS: Monitorar o desempenho e o perfil financeiro da carteira de boletão e dos alunos DIS, identificando riscos, oportunidades e padrões de comportamento de pagamento. Apoiar na definição de estratégias diferenciadas de cobrança para esses públicos;
  • Visão de Mercado e Concorrência: Realizar análises comparativas com práticas de mercado, benchmark de indicadores de cobrança e tendências do setor educacional e financeiro. Apoiar o posicionamento estratégico da área frente à concorrência e ao ambiente macroeconômico.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em cursos de Engenharias, Estatística, Gestão de Projetos, Administração, Economia, Matemática, Ciência da Computação e Sistemas de Informação ou Correlatos;
  • Profissional com forte domínio técnico financeiro e visão analítica ampla, capaz de conectar resultados operacionais e financeiros em uma visão integrada do P&L da cobrança;
  • Experiência comprovada em planejamento financeiro, performance, controladoria ou inteligência financeira, preferencialmente em operações de cobrança ou crédito;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel, Power BI, SQL e modelagem financeira;

Oferecemos um ambiente em que todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional com pessoas engajadas em entregar os melhores resultados, assim como grandes oportunidades de crescimento para você.

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana , da superação de resultados , do foco no cliente , da sustentabilidade , da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore. Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde . Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Join to apply for the Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing role at Go! Running Tours.

Hi… My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast-paced, bullet-pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let's start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that – if you are a runner and marketeer – probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban. You'll be working on a newsletter and pling! An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors. Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more...right? I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it. I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You'll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don't throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You'll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we'll back you while you do). You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that 'makes sense' to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;-)). My guess is that if you are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies! We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone in any way. We're just on the other side of the world. The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you – running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast-moving, and positive company should. The Contract Details Are As Follows: USD 1,400 a month. 25 hrs a week. Managed via Upwork. Oh, and hey… if you're considering this role as an add-on to an already existing full-time job, then hold your horses. I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don't execute, we can't move the needle. That's it, I think. I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me via (contact) with a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please – we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version). Thanks for reading this far, Lena. Note: we usually take down our job posts within 3-4 days as we receive many applicants.

title: General Manager
description:
Overview

Fairmont Hotels is a globally renowned luxury brand, celebrated for creating unforgettable memories for our guests. With more than 30,000 colleagues worldwide, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional service, embracing innovation, and fostering a culture of excellence.

Hotel Overview

Perched on the world-famous Copacabana Beach, the Fairmont Copacabana is one of Rio de Janeiro’s most prestigious luxury addresses and a symbol of the city’s glamorous lifestyle. With 375 rooms and suites, many offering panoramic views of the ocean and Sugar Loaf Mountain, the hotel blends timeless elegance with the vibrant energy of Rio.

As a leading destination for both leisure and business travelers, the hotel boasts extensive meeting and event spaces, hosting everything from high-profile international conferences to glamorous weddings and social gatherings. With its enviable beachfront location, modern design infused with local culture, and a legacy of warm Brazilian hospitality, the Fairmont Copacabana embodies the art de vivre of Fairmont while standing as an icon of Rio de Janeiro’s luxury hotel scene.

Job Description

As the General Manager of Fairmont Copacabana , you will embody the essence of luxury hospitality. Your dynamic and hands-on approach is fueled by a deep passion for developing people and fostering an entrepreneurial spirit. A true brand and guest ambassador, you will challenge conventions, consistently seek solutions, and infuse innovation into every facet of the hotel experience and every function of the business.

Your seasoned leadership style will blend diplomacy with relationship-building prowess, cultivating strong connections with both internal and external stakeholders, including Owners and the Community. Your ability to engage with ownership and strategize revenue enhancements will be coupled with an innate talent for envisioning the hotel's long-term trajectory.

A refined sense of finance and business acumen will be at the core of your decision-making, grounded in an unwavering commitment to delivering a world-class product and service. By seamlessly weaving local heritage and culture into our offerings, you will not only create an authentic guest experience but also drive excellence across all dimensions of our operations.

In your role as a catalyst for exceptional service, you will uphold the highest standards, infusing every interaction with the kind of genuine care that leaves an indelible mark on our guests. Nurturing an environment of continuous growth and skill development, you will inspire our colleagues to consistently exceed expectations, turning moments into memories for every visitor.

As a visionary leader, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our strategic direction. Your involvement in goal setting and objective communication will propel business growth and solidify the hotel’s reputation as a distinguished luxury destination. Your ability to foster positive relationships with ownership will ensure a harmonious partnership that aligns with our overarching strategy while enhancing the hotel's performance and prestige.

Your leadership will be synonymous with setting industry benchmarks and redefining luxury hospitality. Your commitment to excellence, coupled with your innovative approach, will leave an enduring mark on our iconic brand and create a legacy of unparalleled guest memories.

Reporting Structure

The General Manager of Fairmont Copacabana will report to the Cluster Delegate Manager for Rio de Janeiro Luxury Hotels , as part of the unique cluster structure that unites Accor’s flagship luxury properties in the city.

Qualifications

Key Behaviours and Responsibilities:

  1. 1. Act with an open mindset:
    • Embrace innovative ideas, adapt to change, and encourage a culture of innovation and continuous learning.
    • Demonstrate explicit knowledge and awareness of company standards as an integral role model.
    • Build quality relationships with the management team.
    • Create an environment that encourages innovation, challenges traditional thinking, and fosters a "speak-up" culture.
  2. 2. Create positive impact working with others:
    • Foster an inclusive and collaborative work environment, empowering colleagues to contribute their best and building strong relationships based on trust and respect.
    • Create a collaborative and inclusive environment where all colleagues are encouraged to provide input.
    • Actively listen to team members' ideas, concerns, and feedback and incorporate their input into decision-making processes.
    • Recognize and appreciate the contributions and well-being of colleagues.
  3. 3. Strive for guest/client satisfaction:
    • Exhibits a deep understanding of the luxury hospitality landscape and guest expectations, ensuring that the guest experience consistently exceeds industry standards.
    • Maintain product and service quality standards by conducting ongoing evaluations.
    • Handle VIP Guests and understand international protocols for government officials and royalty.
    • Monitor guest/client feedback, address concerns promptly, and implement improvements to optimize satisfaction.
  4. 4. Consistently deliver excellence:
    • Demonstrates a comprehensive understanding of ownership group's investment objectives and formulates strategic business plans that align with those objectives; ensuring preservation and maximization of the hotel’s assets.
    • Set high performance standards, lead by example, and drive a culture of continuous improvement and quality across all the hotel.
    • Exhibits expertise in sales, marketing, and revenue management, driving the hotel's performance in the luxury hospitality market.
    • Maximize financial performance, control costs, and execute marketing and operational activities that produce results meeting or exceeding the hotel's business plan.
    • Recognize and reward outstanding performance and celebrate achievements within the organization.
  5. 5. Enable team success:
    • Support the professional growth and development of colleagues through coaching, mentoring, and providing opportunities for learning.
    • Encourage individuals to take on challenging assignments and stretch their capabilities.
    • Provide regular feedback and guidance, recognizing achievements and offering constructive suggestions for improvement.
    • Create a safe and empowering environment where individuals feel comfortable taking risks, expressing their ideas, and learning from failures.
    • As applicable, brings experience in working with labor unions, maintaining constructive relationships and ensuring harmonious teamwork.
  6. 6. Create clarity:
    • Articulates a clear and comprehensive vision for the hotel, aligning goals and objectives with ownership group's investment strategy.
    • Effectively communicates organizational vision, goals, and expectations, fostering a shared sense of purpose and direction among team members.
    • Demonstrates adeptness in overseeing renovation projects, maintaining transparency and open communication throughout the process.
    • Addresses ambiguity and navigates complex situations with transparency, fostering an environment of clear direction and effective problem-solving.
  7. 7. Inspire for top performance:
    • Lead with passion and integrity, motivate and inspire others to achieve their best.
    • Market plans and ideas successfully, reducing key and complex ideas and messages to clear, memorable, and compelling statements.
    • Embodies an entrepreneurial spirit, inspiring innovative thinking and fostering a culture that encourages taking calculated risks.
    • Recognizes and rewards outstanding performance, cultivating an atmosphere of achievement and recognition.
    • Promotes continuous development and growth, offering resources and guidance to nurture professional skills and talents.
    • Champions a "speak-up" culture, creating an environment where diverse opinions are valued, and individual contributions are celebrated.
    • Convince others, negotiate, debate, and find win-win solutions.

Additional Information

Prior experience in a luxury hotel General Manager position, in large hotel(s) (mandatory)

Fluent in English and in Portuguese or Spanish (mandatory)

Experience in working in Latin America, preferably in Brazil (mandatory)

Proven track record of building a strong service, and quality culture

Strong people skills and a track record of fostering positive, inclusive, high-performing cultures.

Experience in managing owner relations.

Demonstrated leadership, organizational, and interpersonal skills.

Strategic thinker with excellent communication and presentation skills.

Displays a strong entrepreneurial spirit

Bottom-line oriented with a focus on quality guest service and team-building.

Creative and innovative mindset.

Ability to collaborate and work in a fast-paced environment.

Excellent sense of prioritization and time management.

Professional demeanor and strategic orientation.

Engaging, friendly, and charismatic with a natural ability to connect with guests.

Passionate about creating memorable experiences and turning moments into memories

description:
Sobre a Empresa

A Alimak Group é um provedor global de soluções sustentáveis de acesso vertical e trabalho em altura, listado na Nasdaq Stockholm (Suécia).

Com presença em mais de 120 países, o Grupo desenvolve, fabrica, vende e presta serviços em soluções de acesso vertical e trabalho em altura, com foco em agregar valor ao cliente por meio de maior segurança, produtividade elevada e eficiência de custos aprimorada.

Os produtos e soluções do Grupo são comercializados sob as marcas Alimak, Scanclimber, Tractel, CoxGomyl, Manntech e Avanti, marcas reconhecidas pelo mercado e conhecidas por seu sólido histórico de segurança, alta qualidade e durabilidade.

Sobre o Cargo

TÉCNICO DE SERVIÇOS (ONSHORE E OFFSHORE)

Responsabilidades

Realizar manutenções preventivas e corretivas dos elevadores e demais maquinários comercializados pela Alimak no Brasil e demais países América do Sul com foco em tecnologia de painéis elétricos.

Requisitos

  • Certificação técnica ou graduação em elétrica/eletrônica;
  • Conhecimento sobre a instalação, operação e reparo de equipamentos em geral;
  • Experiencia em elevadores a tração;
  • Disponibilidade para viajar;
  • Experiência com instalação, montagem e/ou manutenção de equipamentos e maquinários robustos e com tecnologia avançada;
  • Domínio em elétrica/painéis elétricos;
  • Experiência no setor de Elevadores, Pinhão, Cremalheira e Tração são um diferencial para essa posição;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar externo/em campo com flexibilidade para as mobilizações necessárias dentro da América do Sul;
  • Habilidade para trabalhos em altura;
  • Ler, interpretar procedimentos e instruções técnicas;
  • Flexibilidade para trabalhar em dias e horários conforme demandado pelos clientes.

Resumo das atribuições

  • Realizar inspeções periódicas para detectar possíveis falhas nos equipamentos, principalmente motores e freios;
  • Realizar manutenções preventivas/corretivas dos equipamentos e maquinários comercializados;
  • Elaborar relatórios de visita, execução e medições.

Requisitos Complementares

  • Ensino técnico completo em áreas correlatas, PREFERENCIALMENTE EM ELÉTRICA;
  • Disposição para trabalhar viajando por longos períodos;
  • Flexibilidade de horários e de agenda;
  • Conhecimento básico em Microsoft Office necessários para operar dispositivos móveis;
  • CNH Ativa;
  • Leitura e interpretação de desenhos e demais documentos técnicos;
  • Experiência anterior comprovada em funções similares em indústrias e/ou plataformas offshore.

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde e seguro dental 100% cobertos pela empresa, extensivo a familiares/dependentes;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Ticket alimentação;
  • Treinamento técnico;

Esta posição tem local de trabalho em Rio de Janeiro/RJ na Divisão de Medicamentos de Marca e Produtos Farmacêuticos .

Estamos comprometidos em prover os benefícios de nossos medicamentos de confiança para mais pessoas nos países que mais crescem e se desenvolvem no mundo. A Aegea foi criada em 2010. É líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Cada município onde atua leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Descrição da Vaga

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Somos a equipe de Tech Strategy & Advisory da Accenture, referência global em como tecnologia e inovação reinventam negócios e promovem mais competitividade para qualquer empresa. Nossa missão é apoiar executivos de alto nível a trazer disrupção aos seus setores, aproveitando o poder da tecnologia para capturar market share.

A área de Tech Strategy combina conhecimento profundo de negócios e de domínios tecnológicos para ajudar nossos clientes a se tornarem mais competitivos, liberando valor e acelerando crescimento. Em um mundo marcado por transformações constantes, o C‑Suite precisa posicionar a tecnologia como diferencial estratégico, capaz de garantir agilidade e resiliência aos negócios. Novas arquiteturas de negócio e de tecnologia rompem com modelos tradicionais, criando a base necessária para competir e crescer nesse novo cenário.

A Accenture Tech Strategy & Advisory possibilita que líderes atuem com rapidez e confiança ao direcionar suas organizações para o futuro. Capacitamos organizações a reinventarem seus modelos de operação e crescimento, aplicando Inteligência Artificial Generativa e Agentes, plataformas avançadas de dados e analytics, automação inteligente e ciber‑resiliência – sempre com agilidade, escala e impacto tangível para o negócio.

O papel

Como Consultor/a de Technology Strategy & Advisory, você atuará diretamente nas transformações que envolvem tecnologia em nossos clientes, ajudando a definir visões ousadas e roadmaps práticos. Você ajudará nossos clientes a identificar oportunidades de valor, a estruturar business cases sólidos, a pensar na modernização de suas áreas de Digital/IT/OT e a definir modelos operacionais que integrem negócios e tecnologia.

Qualificações exigidas

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas; idealmente com pós‑graduação ou MBA.
  • Pelo menos 2 a 4 anos de experiência em consultoria de estratégia ou função equivalente, com exposição a tecnologia + negócio.
  • Compreensão clara de conceitos relacionados a negócios e operação de modelos de TI, com roadmaps, business cases, modelagens financeiras e otimização operacional.
  • Habilidade analítica avançada, inclusive com uso de dados, visualização e storytelling executivo.
  • Forte comunicação, influência e relacionamento com stakeholders seniores.
  • Desejável conhecimento prático em tecnologias emergentes, incluindo fundamentos de Inteligência Artificial (Machine Learning, LLMs, GenAI) e uso de Agentes de AI para automação, tomada de decisão e orquestração de processos.

Diferenciais

  • Perfil pró‑ativo para inovação e pensamento crítico.
  • Participação em iniciativas de avaliação de custo completo / eficiência de TI.
  • Fluência em inglês (e preferivelmente outro idioma além do português).

  • Vivência em projetos que envolvam aplicação de AI Generativa ou Agentes Inteligentes (por exemplo: copilotos, assistentes digitais, automação baseada em linguagem natural).
  • Capacidade de traduzir possibilidades técnicas de AI em oportunidades de negócio, integrando essas soluções em roadmaps estratégicos.

title: Software Developer
description:
Select how often (in days) to receive an alert:

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 20,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

The Senior Software Developper calls for an experienced, knowledgeable, and talented individual to design and develop software for the User Configurable Open System (UCOS) product.

As a senior software engineer, you will have an opportunity to apply your versatile embedded, systems, and application software development skills to UCOS’s expanding use in myriad industrial controls and automation systems and Industrial IoT.You will lead and collaborate with other engineers while contributing at all phases of the software development lifecycle.

Job Description

  • Architect, design, implement, test and deliver high quality, performant software products.
  • Work cross functionally with software, application, and quality engineers to ensure products meet engineering and client success criteria.
  • Actively participate in the definition and implementation of new processes and improvements
  • Identify and create new technologies and ideas to increase the organization’s intellectual property and to better address customer needs.
  • Present your designs and solutions to internal and external teams and review designs of software and quality engineers.
  • Develop test plans and test automation processes to increase automated functional tests.
  • Mentor team in development/test technologies, tools, and processes

You are meant for this job if:

  • Requires a Bachelor of Science degree or related
  • Expertise in software engineering
  • Expert experience in C/C++, developing embedded software and systems software
  • Deep knowledge of object-oriented programming and experience with at least one of (Java, C#, Python, Ruby)
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies (such as Docker), Kubernetes technologies (such K3S, Helm charts, Rancher), and IoT protocols (MQTT, REST API, Kafka)
  • Knowledge of cloud technologies such as AWS
  • Systems software programming knowledge of Windows and Linux OS
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft MFC (Microsoft Foundation Class), WPF, Qt, or similar GUI framework
  • Understanding of database technologies such as SQL, ODBC, and relational database schema design
  • Understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP), wired interfaces (Ethernet, USB), and wireless interfaces (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Cell, Satellite)
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining APIs for internal/external services
  • Exposure to the principals of Industrial Protocols, Platforms and APIs: OPC (DA & UA), Profibus, Profinet, Modbus (RTU, TCP, Enron), EtherIP, etc.
  • Exposure to serial communication protocols (I2C, RS-485, RS-232, CAN, SPI)
  • Exposure to industry standard embedded design and debugging tools is a plus (JTAG, protocol analyzers, emulators)
  • Exposure to Configuration Management tools (Version control, bug tracking, change management, automated builds, and coding standards)
  • Exposure to developing in agile and Iterative Software development processes
  • Excellent verbal and written communications skills

Skills

TechnipFMC promotes diversity, equity, and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, sexual orientations, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matters and we encourage you to add to our culture.

description:
FIFA has created a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Department: Partnerships & Media

Location: Brazil

THE POSITION

The Senior Partnership Manager will be responsible for managing and delivering FIFA’s commercial partner rights at the local level, ensuring seamless coordination with the global FIFA Partnership Management team in Zurich. This includes day‑to‑day relationship management, operational delivery at venues and events where required, and strategic alignment with partner objectives within the host country and region.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Proactively lead and foster relationships with FIFA Commercial Partners operating in Brazil, ensuring consistent, high‑quality servicing in line with global standards.
  • Act as the key local point of contact for assigned Commercial Partner, ensuring continuous alignment and close collaboration with the Partnership Management team at FIFA Zurich to maintain consistent servicing and delivery across all touchpoints.
  • Lead assigned partnership projects and deliverables related to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ in Brazil, ensuring on‑time, in‑scope, and on‑budget execution while identifying meaningful, locally relevant business and marketing opportunities that enhance partner impact and remain aligned with FIFA’s global partnership and brand strategy.
  • Project lead for assigned local partner activations and FIFA‑related events in Brazil (e.g. Local Commercial Partner Workshops).
  • Ensure local partner activations and brand visibility adhere to FIFA’s third‑party regulations and brand protection standards, working in close coordination with the Commercial Legal and Brand teams.
  • Track and manage local partner budgets and support reconciliation processes in close coordination with the Zurich Partnerships team.
  • Prepare and lead meetings and updates with internal and external stakeholders, including regular reporting to the Partnership Management team at FIFA Zurich.
  • Provide solution‑oriented, proactive support to the Head of Commercial Partnerships in Brazil and contribute to a unified servicing approach across global and local workstreams.
  • Support continuous improvement by feeding local market insights and operational learnings into FIFA’s global partnership tools and client servicing frameworks.

YOUR PROFILE

  • University degree required, preferably in Business, Marketing, Sports Management, or a related field
  • A solid understanding of the business of sports, marketing, and sponsorship rights delivery
  • Project and event management experience, ideally in an international environment
  • Working knowledge of digital and social media is an advantage
  • 6–8 years of experience in brand marketing, sponsorship, or client servicing in the sports or entertainment industry
  • Proven track record of managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders
  • Experience working in or with international organizations and global brands
  • Familiarity with the Brazilian market and local executional landscape is a strong asset
  • Client‑oriented with strong interpersonal and written communication skills
  • Efficient and effective time management and organizational skills
  • Ability to define priorities, lead projects independently, and provide direction to junior team members when required
  • Team‑oriented, service‑minded, and collaborative across functions
  • Strategic and creative problem‑solver with a hands‑on mindset
  • Comfortable working under pressure, managing multiple priorities and deadlines
  • Strong sense of ownership, initiative, and accountability
  • High level of professionalism, empathy, and commercial awareness
  • Strong representation skills, both internally and externally
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Seniority level: Mid‑Senior level
